lines.text: Jesus goes to Gethsemane with His disciples and takes Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, sorrowful and deeply distressed.
Jesus falls facedown and prays that the cup pass from Him, then finds the disciples sleeping.
Jesus prays a fourth time, saying the same thing, and then tells the disciples the hour is near.
Judas arrives with a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, and he identifies Jesus with a bow.
A companion cuts off the ear of the high priest's servant, Jesus says Scripture must be fulfilled, and the disciples flee.
